name: Necklace
description: Miao silver jewelry has a long history, and its forging skills were included in the first batch of national intangible cultural heritage lists. With its diverse varieties, wonderful shapes and exquisite craftsmanship, it not only depicts a magnificent and colorful art world to people, but also embodies its aesthetic value from four different dimensions: the beauty of history, the beauty of culture, the beauty of craftsmanship, and the beauty of totems.
